basic_details.short_information: Office of the Collector, North, Panaji Goa and Office of the Collector, South, Margao, Goa (Goa Collectorate) has invited applications for 94 posts in 5 roles under Advt No. 95/3/2026/Recruitment/COM/CAB. The posts include Upper Division Clerk (Collectorate of North Goa), Lower Division Clerk (Collectorate of North Goa), Lower Division Clerk (Collectorate of South Goa), Multi Tasking Staff (Collectorate of North Goa) and 1 more. Applications are accepted online until 27 November 2026.

content_sections.text: Apply only online on https://itggoa.formsubmit.in. Read the general instructions for filling the form on the same portal. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Goa Collectorate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Goa Collectorate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 94 vacancies: 11 Upper Division Clerk (Collectorate of North Goa), 33 Lower Division Clerk (Collectorate of North Goa), 41 Lower Division Clerk (Collectorate of South Goa), 4 Multi Tasking Staff (Collectorate of North Goa), 5 Multi Tasking Staff (Collectorate of South Goa).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Goa Collectorate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR: Rs. 600. SC/ST: Rs. 200. OBC: Rs. 300. PwD: Nil. EWS: Rs. 300.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on the last date of application). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwD 10 years, PwD (SC/ST) 15 years, PwD (OBC) 13 years, Ex-servicemen As per Orders/Rules in force, Government servants and employees of office of Administrator of Comunidades Up to 5 years, Overall maximum 56 years for all categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 4 for Upper Division Clerk (Collectorate of North Goa), Level 2 for Lower Division Clerk (Collectorate of North Goa), Level 2 for Lower Division Clerk (Collectorate of South Goa), Level 1 for Multi Tasking Staff (Collectorate of North Goa), Level 1 for Multi Tasking Staff (Collectorate of South Goa).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UDC: Bachelor's Degree, one year administrative experience, 6 months computer certificate, Konkani. LDC: Higher Secondary School Certificate, computer knowledge with 30 wpm English typing, one year experience, Konkani. MTS: SSC or ITI certificate in relevant trade, one year experience, Konkani. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Konkani is essential. LDC: typing speed of 30 words per minute in English.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who do not possess required qualification as per Recruitment Rules should not apply. Candidates without valid OBC certificate, including OBC creamy layer, shall apply under UR.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Objective-type written test. Merit list based on marks in written test. Skill test wherever applicable for candidates qualified in merit list. Verification of essential documents.
